name: YMS Auto-Darkening Welding Safety Goggles with Adjustable Strap
shortDescription: Compact lightweight auto-darkening eye protection goggles (DIN 3 to DIN 11) with dual solar sensors, ideal for confined space welding and gas cutting.
overview: The YMS Auto-Darkening Welding Goggles provide a streamlined, lightweight alternative to bulky full-face welding helmets when working in restricted spaces, under vehicle chassis, or performing gas welding and plasma cutting. Featuring an intelligent auto-darkening liquid crystal filter, the goggles transition automatically from a transparent shade DIN 3 to dark shade DIN 11 in less than 5/10,000th of a second upon sensing arc light. The soft elastomeric body contours comfortably to the facial profile, and integrated indirect air ventilation ports prevent interior fogging while keeping out flying sparks.
keyFeatures: Compact low-profile form factor ideal for tight overhead and crawl-space welding
Rapid auto-darkening transition from shade DIN 3 to DIN 11 in 0.5 milliseconds
Dual solar cells assist integrated lithium battery for completely autonomous operation
UV/IR radiation shielding up to DIN 15 throughout entire welding cycle
Soft flexible PVC goggle frame with adjustable elastic headband for a leak-proof seal
Indirect anti-fog ventilation channels stop lens condensation during humid shifts
Can be paired easily with earmuffs, hard hats, and half-mask respirators

specifications.Power Source: Solar Cells + Built-in Lithium Button Battery

applications: Plasma arc cutting and carbon arc torch work
Tack welding and confined space pipe inspections
